tagline: A ridgeline road with nowhere to be.
intro: The Blue Ridge Parkway links Shenandoah National Park in Virginia to Great Smoky Mountains National Park in North Carolina. It was designed for driving slowly, with no commercial traffic, frequent overlooks, and mileposts in place of exits.
Sections close for weather and repairs, so check the National Park Service before a long trip.
season: Spring bloom at the higher elevations, October for colour.
